device.description: Automotive 12-bit 2 MSPS SAR ADC with SPI-compatible serial interface
device.note: ads7049-q1.pdf (SBAS763) p.3 pin configuration and functions, p.4 recommended operating conditions, p.6 timing (Figure 1), p.15 transfer characteristics (Table 1), p.16 serial interface, p.17-19 offset calibration

pages: p.3 (pins), p.4 (ROC), p.6 (timing, Figure 1), p.15 (transfer characteristics), p.16 (serial interface), p.17-19 (offset calibration)
notModeled: analog input (single-ended input); conversion is clocked by SCLK (the 12.5-SCLK conversion is not timed: the result is the 0 V code at once)

offset calibration (power-up: the first frame after power-up outputs zeros while the OCR is calibrated with at least 16 SCLKs, which the 0 V code already is; the 32-SCLK calibration frame during normal operation)
throughput, acquisition time and SCLK frequency limits
tFloat: the datasheet gives only a 5 ns minimum for tDZ_CSDO
tOut uses tD_CKDO 25 ns (AVDD 2.35-3.6 V, the whole AVDD range)
